hero.title: Stok Kangri Base Camp Expedition
hero.bookingText: Visit summitgrid.co/stok-kangri for full spec sheet & booking

overview.text: A technical high-altitude module to Stok Kangri base camp, engineered for acclimatization efficiency across Ladakh's cold desert terrain.

itinerary.title: Leh Arrival & Rest Protocol
itinerary.description: Arrival at Leh, mandatory rest and acclimatization day, briefing on high-altitude protocols.

itinerary.title: Drive to Stok Village & Trek to Base Camp
itinerary.description: Drive to Stok village, begin trek along the Stok stream to base camp.

itinerary.title: Base Camp to Advance Camp
itinerary.description: Move to advance camp with progressive altitude gain, gear check for summit push.

itinerary.title: Summit Push & Return to Base
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn summit attempt, weather-dependent, followed by descent to base camp.

itinerary.title: Contingency & Descent to Stok
itinerary.description: Weather buffer day if required, otherwise descent to Stok village.

itinerary.title: Drive Back to Leh & Departure
itinerary.description: Drive back to Leh for departure or onward connections.

inclusions.title: Camping Modules
inclusions.description: Alpine tents rated for sub-zero conditions.

inclusions.title: Ration Support
inclusions.description: High-calorie expedition meals, all days covered.

inclusions.title: Technical Crew
inclusions.description: Certified high-altitude guides and support staff.

inclusions.title: Medical Ops
inclusions.description: Oxygen support, satellite phone and evacuation plan.

faqs.question: Is prior high-altitude experience required?
faqs.answer: Yes, prior trekking above 4,500m is strongly recommended before attempting this module.

faqs.question: What is the summit success rate?
faqs.answer: Weather-dependent; historical success rate is approximately 70% for acclimatized climbers.

faqs.question: Is oxygen support provided?
faqs.answer: Emergency oxygen is carried by the technical crew for the summit push.

footer.title: Summit Grid Expeditions
footer.description: Engineered ascents. Zero margin for error.
